caseName: Hunter v. U.S. Dist. Court for the E. Dist. of Va.
caseNameFull: Chase Carmen HUNTER v. UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT FOR the EASTERN DISTRICT OF VIRGINIA.

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperisdenied, and petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit dismissed. See Rule 39.8.
